paragraphs: CourtReserve makes software for running racquet and paddle sports clubs. The platform covers bookings, payments, memberships, events and a mobile app. It is built for racquet and paddle sports facilities.

Clubs run everything from court reservations to payments in one system. Invoicing and billing are automated to keep the books tidy. Players find their club, search and book from a phone. The player app is available on iOS and Android. The company advertises US-based support.

In a letter on the site, Tim Owens writes that back in 2016 he and Ashley, driven by a love for tennis and pickleball, set out to change how clubs and facilities are run. The same letter describes a community that ranges from local clubs to organizations such as the USTA, PTR and PPR. Case studies present the software as a way to simplify scheduling, grow membership and manage reservable spaces. One of them says the pickleball operator Dill Dinkers adopted CourtReserve as its club management system from day one.

quote.text: We build modern tools for managing racquet & paddle sports clubs.
